udt_error_enum_v0.doc:
Errors returned by the Factory contract. Codes are a published ABI.

Factory codes occupy `11000-11999`; the shared band contract lives in `contracts/pool/src/error.rs`.

| Band   | Range       | What it means                   | Retriable            |
|--------|-------------|---------------------------------|----------------------|
| Input  | `x000\xe2\x80\x93x099` | Argument malformed              | No \xe2\x80\x94 fix the call    |
| Policy | `x100\xe2\x80\x93x199` | Not the admin                   | No \xe2\x80\x94 get authorized  |
| State  | `x200\xe2\x80\x93x299` | Mutable state forbids it now    | When state changes   |
| Ext    | `x400\xe2\x80\x93x499` | A candidate coin's token failed | Depends on the token |
udt_error_enum_v0.name: Error

function_v0.doc:
Deploy and register a pool from a registered implementation.

Permissionless: `deployer` is authorized only to prove identity.
Duplicates are allowed \xe2\x80\x94 the salt is the pool counter, so identical
deploys cannot collide. Coin order is fixed verbatim and never sorted; coin 0's position is
permanent, as it is the base the pool's price oracle prices every other coin against.

- `deployer`: pays for and is recorded as the deployer; does not gate the call.
- `name`, `symbol`: the LP share token's name and symbol.
- `coins`: token addresses; order is permanent, with coin 0 as the price-oracle base.
- `a`: amplification coefficient, unscaled.
- `fee`: swap fee charged on each trade.
- `offpeg_fee_multiplier`: scales the fee up as the pool depegs.
- `implementation_idx`: which registered implementation to deploy.
- `ma_exp_time`, `asset_types`, `method_ids`, `oracles`: reserved for asset-type-1 (rate-oracle)
support, which this build does not implement. They are currently accepted but ignored \xe2\x80\x94 only
`asset_types.le

function_v0.doc:
First step in a two-step ownership transfer: records `new_admin` as pending.

Step two is `accept_transfer_ownership`, which the pending admin calls to take authority.
The two steps make the new admin prove they can sign before any authority moves,
so a typo in the address can't hand the pools to a key nobody controls.

- `new_admin`: the address that may later accept to become the Factory admin.
